0022600203.text: The Lakers (9-2, first in the Pacific and first in the West, on a five-game winning streak) visit the Atlanta Hawks (7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, on a four-game winning streak) in the Lakers' 12th game of the season. Los Angeles will be without Austin Reaves (illness) and Quentin Grimes (finger), while Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Lakers winning the most recent meeting 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026, and they have not met yet this season.
